narrative_purpose: Shows the convective engine at full extension, and specifically shows its flat base as a level - the altitude where rising air surrenders its vapour - so the lifting condensation level becomes a thing the reader can point at.
subject: A single enormous convective cloud tower rising over unbroken rainforest in late afternoon. Its base is conspicuously flat and level, at a clear height above the canopy, and several smaller clouds nearby share exactly the same flat base height, so the base reads as a contour rather than a coincidence. Above the base the tower boils upward in hard cauliflower masses and spreads into a broad flat anvil near the top. Beneath the tower a dark column of heavy rain reaches the canopy.
scene: Late afternoon over lowland rainforest, one mature storm cell dominating an otherwise open sky, the banded limb of a gas giant faint and low in the background.
camera: Distant ground-level or low-aerial view of the whole cloud from base to anvil, the tower fitting entirely within the frame.
light: Warm low sun raking the tower's flank from one side so its boiling structure reads in relief; the rain column and cloud base in deep cool shadow.
palette: Bright warm-lit cloud flank against void-indigo sky, cool teal-grey cloud shadow, living-teal canopy below, a dim amber-grey gas-giant limb.
style: Painterly plate reading as a diagram through its structure; real convective cloud rendering with soft volumetric mass, NOT a hard vector schematic and NOT a 3D render.
detail_level: High on the tower's boiling flank and its flat base; the anvil softening at the top, the distant canopy dissolving into haze.
composition: Tower set slightly off-centre and rising nearly the full height of the frame, its flat base crossing the composition as a strong horizontal, and clear sky on the opposite side kept plain for callouts.
consistency_notes: The flat, shared cloud base is the teaching feature and must be unmistakably level across every cloud in the frame. Canopy in the chapter's living teal; cloud in the cooler water-in-air palette.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no grid, no diagram chrome, no photographic or 3D-render look, no ragged or sloping cloud base
